full_name: VA survey: 100 yes/no questions on recognising everyday objects at typical viewing distances
domains: self-reported recognition of object details at given viewing distances (single latent trait, vision ability)
response_scale: yes / no (not applicable allowed if scenario unfamiliar)
scoring: 2PL IRT (mirt v1.40 in R) vision ability theta; linear regression converts theta to estimated VA (Estimated VA = 0.59 - 0.33 x theta, logMAR)
target_population: adults 18+ across the full VA range (-0.3 to 2 logMAR)
notes: survey took 30 to 60 minutes (range; interviewer-administered by phone or in clinic); item VA thresholds range 0.15 to 1.47 logMAR; 5 of 100 items misfit (Q12, Q23, Q35, Q49, Q79); full item list in Supplementary Table S1 (not in text); no sensitivity/specificity reported; example item 'Would you be able to see the eye of a needle, if you hold it at arm's length?'
